text_block_list.text: One day, while passing by the school gate――

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, still not enough power.
And El's out of finisher moves now, too.
...Huuuh.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Truth is, I was just gathering power into my body de-su.
Getting ready to give it my all in the next race!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: If I lose in a contest of pure power, I'll have no right to face my wrestler papa!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
—Of course!
Passing by like this must be fate!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Do you have any recommended ways to power up-desu?!
Please tell me!
choice_data_list: How about getting a stamina set meal?
How about sprinting while pulling tires?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ohh! I get it!
If I build up power from the inside out...!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Strike while the iron is hot! Let's charge
straight for the cafeteriaaa!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Oooohhh~! Burning passion, problem solved, El Happiness!
I'll take that idea-desu!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I'm totally fired up! Charging onto the track right nooooow!
